1.e4 c6 2.d4 d5 3.exd5 cxd5 4.c4 Nf6 5.N.strategy: The natural development: it guards d4 and controls e5 while keeping the pressure on d5, so Black must decide how to meet the tension. White aims for a lead in development and an open centre, with the isolated d4 pawn as the structural price if the centre is resolved.

Pins the knight on c3 against the king, so the piece that attacks d5 can neither take there nor move away. Black also threatens to double White's pawns with ...Bxc3, trading the bishop for a knight to take the sting out of the pressure on d5.
1.e4 c6 2.d4 d5 3.exd5 cxd5 4.c4 Nf6 5.N.name: Caro–Kann Defence: Panov Attack, Main Line
